Definition: strengthened from the base of G5157; to twist, i.e. turn quite around or reverse (literally or figuratively):--convert, turn (again, back again, self, self about).
BiblicalUsage: To turn is the act that changes everything, and the Gospels turn on it. Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven; the Lord turned and looked upon Peter, and Peter remembered; and Mary turned herself back and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the turning is conversion in one word: turn as a child, turn at the Lord's look, and turn to see Him standing.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
